text:
Alex: quick async — kernel changes landed to reduce tail latency for short prompts, pushed canary to staging at 2x microbatch.
Priya: nice, saw the canary traces. tail p95 down ~18% on q2 workloads.
Matt: thanks — CI is failing on that new prefetch test, repro on my laptop, throwing OOM at step 42.
Alex: ack, looking into it now. might be double-alloc in kv_prefetch when batch_size==1.
Sara: leaving notes in the PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/3245 — added a small patch suggestion.
Anders: pinging infra — the staging GPU node that runs the perf harness is at 92% mem due to other experiments, can we move run to node-5?
CI-Bot: test-suite/staging-perf triggered by @Alex — 6 tests queued, 1 running.
Priya: re: benchmarks — added last night's runs to the dashboard, see heatmap: /dashboards/kernel/latency. For the small-chat workload microbatch=4 handles cost better.
Matt: blocker: need a +1 on the PR with the prefetch fix before I can re-run perf. Sara any time to review?
Sara: will do a quick pass now, focusing on the alloc/free path and kv eviction hooks.
Alex: flag: if we change prefetch logic we need to adjust the KV warmup script — otherwise we see regression at p99 for long-context.
Anders: noted. I'll schedule a short canary on node-5 after Sara approves. ETA 30m.
Priya: FYI I found a weird metric — cache-hit ratio drops on steady-state with batch-size 8 after ~10 minutes. suspect eviction threshold too low.
Matt: thanks, I'll add a small logging span around eviction decisions so we can correlate tokens-in-flight with evictions.
Sara: review done, left one nit and one question about atomic ops. Matt can you address and rebase?
Matt: will address now, then re-run perf harness on node-5.
Alex: once we have green perf, let's do a short A/B: current kernel vs patched for 2h at 10qps. Want to capture 95/99 percentile and cost delta.
Priya: I'll configure the A/B in the console and add the eval set.
Anders: after A/B, if stable we can promote to canary in prod tomorrow.
CI-Bot: @Matt's build passed unit tests (6/6) and integration (3/3), perf queued on node-5.
Matt: thanks, rebase pushed. running now.
Sara: small note — if you change eviction thresholds, update the rollout config to include fallback thresholds.
Alex: yup. no other blockers from me. short follow-ups: Matt re-run, Priya standing up A/B, Anders schedule canary.
Priya: on it.
Matt: running, will report results in this thread when done.
Sara: thanks all, ping me if A/B shows p99 regressions.
Alex: closing the loop later today, if anyone sees anything odd lmk in #eng-runtime. :thumbsup:
